AGE & PROPORTIONS (non-negotiable): character is a fully-grown adult about 28-32 years old with standard heroic adult proportions (approximately 6 feet / 180 cm tall in-world). NOT a child, NOT a teenager, NOT elderly, NOT a graybeard wizard.

BODY PROPORTIONS (non-negotiable): realistic adult human head-to-body ratio — the head is approximately 1/7 to 1/8 of the total body height. TALL and SLENDER with long adult legs (roughly half of total height), a full-length adult torso, and normal-sized adult shoulders. NOT chibi, NOT bobblehead, NOT big-head-small-body, NOT child-bodied, NOT stubby. The silhouette must read as a tall adult, never as a kid in adult clothes.

CROSS-ROSTER SCALE (non-negotiable, IDENTICAL for every humanoid): a standard adult human is 180 cm tall in-world and MUST render at the SAME relative pixel height as every other adult humanoid in this sprite set. The only permitted variance is small natural adult build differences (slender vs broad), never scale differences. Do not zoom in on smaller characters or zoom out on larger ones.

Weapons may extend laterally but the character body (feet-to-head) must remain inside the canvas with clearance. Portrait is the ONLY exception and uses a bust-shot crop.

entries.newPrompt:
IDENTITY: Human WOMAN, about 26 years old, long wavy auburn-red hair, warm brown eyes, calm confident adult face.

OUTFIT: Deep-red hooded robe with a yellow-gold flame emblem on the chest, gold trim along the hood and front seam. Hood worn up.

WEAPONS: No staff. A plume of orange-yellow fire flickers in the palms.

POSE (east_spell): East-facing side profile. Both palms held forward cupping a swirling orange-yellow flame, hood up, serene face. Mid-cast.

FRAMING (non-negotiable): FULL-BODY head-to-toe. Feet fully visible with clearance above the bottom edge (NEVER cropped). Head with headroom above the hair. Figure occupies ~85% of canvas height, centered. Match cross-roster scale: same pixel height as every other adult humanoid in this sprite set.

PROPORTIONS: realistic adult human, head ~1/7.5 of body, tall and slender adult legs, NOT chibi, NOT bobblehead.

FOOTWEAR: leather/cloth shoes — never barefoot.

STYLE: pixel art, transparent background, no ground shadow, no borders, no text, bright evenly-lit, match palette of reference.

NEGATIVE: no staff, no sword, no bow, no skull, no male features, no beard, no blue, no ice, no scene background, no white background, no solid color background.
